analysis.reason: 일봉 RSI 과매수 구간에서 중립으로 냉각 중. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 추세 전환을 확정하기엔 부족. 5일 연속 음봉 출현 후 반등 시도하나 거래량 동반 미흡. 20일 이동평균선($270.25) 하향 돌파 후 회복 시도 중이나 저항선($299.29)과의 거리가 10% 이상.
analysis.reasonEn: Daily RSI cooling from overbought to neutral. MACD histogram shows improvement but not enough to confirm trend reversal. Attempting rebound after 5 consecutive down days, but volume is insufficient. Price is attempting to recover after breaking below the 20-day moving average ($270.25), but the distance to the resistance at $299.29 is over 10%.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) - Decision to enter after confirming recovery above the 20-day moving average.
